title: Canonical tensor-pullback, tensor-product and tensor-power comparisons
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $T_j:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_Z)$ be the explicit tensor pullback and $P_j$ the ordinary sheaf pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], on the categories of sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Define $\theta_j:T_j\xrightarrow{\sim}P_j$ to be the comparison from uniqueness of left adjoints to $j_*$, using the normalized tensor-pullback adjunction of [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] (the adjunction $T_j\dashv j_*$ whose unit sends a section $m$ to $1\otimes m$; it is unique, since an adjunction is determined by its unit), and the ordinary pullback adjunction. For any $\mathcal O_X$-modules $A,B$, define $c_j(A,B):T_j(A\otimes B)\xrightarrow{\sim}T_j(A)\otimes T_j(B)$ as $\theta_j(A\otimes B)$, followed by the inverse monoidal multiplication comparison for $P_j$, followed by $\theta_j(A)^{-1}\otimes\theta_j(B)^{-1}$. Tensor products and their unit are those of [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For any $\mathcal O_X$-module $L$, write $L^{\otimes0}=\mathcal O_X$ and $L^{\otimes(d+1)}=L\otimes L^{\otimes d}$. Define $p_j(L,d):T_j(L^{\otimes d})\xrightarrow{\sim}(T_jL)^{\otimes d}$ recursively for every $d\in\mathbb N$: at $d=0$ it is $\theta_j(\mathcal O_X)$ followed by the canonical isomorphism $P_j\mathcal O_X\cong\mathcal O_Z$; at $d+1$ it is $c_j(L,L^{\otimes d})$ followed by $\operatorname{id}_{T_jL}\otimes p_j(L,d)$. These are fixed comparison constructions for arbitrary $j,A,B,L$, without invertibility, immersion or square-zero hypotheses.
